name: PhD-leaning student (F56 research/industry weighting)
description: sector='research' (F56). Verified against the real engine before writing this (eval/run_personas.py's own philosophy): a research lean tags 'Foundations of Functional Programming' (theoretical_cs) up and the two software_methods_tools core modules down, the exact mirror of p01's industry-lean tags. The core order, though, comes out IDENTICAL to the track's own authored order and to p01's reordered-for-industry baseline being different -- because the track YAML already happens to list the one theoretical_cs core module first, a research lean has nothing to move. That's a real, honest finding (not a bug): this persona checks the correct weight tags are still applied even when the resulting order is unchanged, so 'nothing moved' can't silently mean 'nothing happened'.
